summary: Attention window frames on the collections stream carry sync: every snapshot, and a changes frame whenever this host's sync state or the peers it names change

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; the frame field was added to the client contract by stream-sync-contract.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The daemon now sends the optional StreamSync on attention snapshot and changes frames. Clients that predate it ignore the field; a client that reads it no longer needs a page read to learn this host's sync.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions; an older daemon sends no sync and clients fall back to a page's.
